#define LL "%I64d"
#define pb push_back
#define pp pop_back
#define ll long long
#define pll pair<ll, ll>
#define pii pair<int, int>
#define pss pair<string, string>
#define psi pair<string, int>
#define psll pair<string, ll>
#define vi vector<int>
#define vs vector<string>
#define vl vector<ll>
#define vc vector<char>
#define vv <vector<vector> >
#define mp make_pair
#define str(a, b) substr((a), (b))
#define all(v) v.begin(),v.end()
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define endl "\n"
#define sz size()
#define rr return
#define r0 return 0
#define mi map<int>
#define ms map<string>
#define ml map<ll>
#define all_sum(a,b) accumulate((a),(b),0)
#define FOR(i,a,b) for (int i = (a); i < (b); ++i)
#define F0R(i,a) FOR(i,0,a)
#define ROF(i,a,b) for (int i = (b)-1; i >= (a); --i)
#define R0F(i,a) ROF(i,0,a)
using namespace std;
void adskiy_razgon(){
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
	cin.tie(0);
	cout.tie(0);
}
const int mxN=  1e+9+7;
const ll INF = 1e+18+7;
ll nod(ll a, ll b) {
    if(b > a) {
		swap(a, b);
	}
    while(b > 0) {
	    a %= b;
		swap(a, b);
    }
	return a;
}
ll nok(ll a,ll b) {
    return a * b / nod(a, b);
}
void sp(ll a,double b) {
    cout << fixed << setprecision(a) << b;
}

	if (n == 0) {
		return 1;
	}
	if (n % 2 == 1) {
		return binpow (a, n - 1) * a;
	}
	else {
	    ll b = binpow (a, n / 2);
		return b * b;
	}
}

	string s;
	cin >> s;
	bool ok = 0;
	for(int i = 0; i < s.sz; ++i) {
		if(s[i] == 'a' && s[i + 1] == 't' && !ok && i != 0 && (i + 1) != s.sz - 1) {

			cout << '@';

		}

			if(s[i] == 'd' && s[i + 1] == 'o' && s[i + 2] == 't' && i != 0 && (i + 2) != s.sz - 1) {
				cout << '.';
				i += 2;
			}
			else {
				cout << s[i];
			}
		}
	}
}

	adskiy_razgon();
	ll t = 1;
